inspiration: Square retro badge: two 512 px retro icons plus an .ico, the idea being a square badge that reads at favicon size. Refs: Source/ACE.Server/images/ace-retro-icon.png and ace-retro-icon2.png (not viewed).

Themed armour with one signature stat: the Golden Flame armour fix re-copies one magic-absorb float value (property type 159) from the world table for one item id, so each themed piece has one clear signature property. Ref: Database/Updates/Shard/2022-05-14-04-Fix-Aegis-of-the-Golden-Flame.sql (line 1).

Dated, one-item content patches: each fix is a small dated SQL file with a comment header naming the property and the item; easy to review one at a time. Ref: Database/Updates/Shard/ (most by file name only).
Starter loadout as data: starterGear.json lists starting skills by id and name, so the starter kit is a data file, not code. Ref: Source/ACE.Server/starterGear.json.

Motif-led spell names: the file 2023-09-02-00-Update-Spell-Hieroglyph-of-Healing-Mastery.sql suggests spells named after a motif with a mastery tier. Idea only; not opened. Ref: Database/Updates/Shard/2023-09-02-00-Update-Spell-Hieroglyph-of-Healing-Mastery.sql.
